lines.en: label halloweenfive1:
scene sky

It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of Halloween, it was two months until Christmas, it was a tried and true formulaic approach to an intro, it was contrived and boring and lame.
lines.zh: 那是最好的时代，也是最坏的时代；那是万圣节的时代，那是距圣诞节还有两个月的时代，那是一种久经考验、套路化的开场方式，它矫揉造作、无聊透顶、烂得要命。

lines.en: And also it was Friday. And you’ve gotta get down on Friday. So buckle up your wizard hat and lace up your glasses because we’re about to go for one wild ride!
lines.zh: 而且今天是星期五。星期五你就得嗨起来。所以系好你的巫师帽、系紧你的眼镜，因为我们马上要开启一趟疯狂之旅！

lines.en: Or maybe two wild rides.
lines.zh: 也许是两趟疯狂之旅。

lines.en: Or maybe three or maybe four or maybe {i}five{/i} wild rides because no one ever knows what’s going to happen next in Kumon-mi! But there are a few things we {i}do{/i} know for sure.
lines.zh: 也许是三趟、四趟、或者{i}五{/i}趟疯狂之旅，因为没人知道 Kumon-mi 下一秒会发生什么！但有那么几件事我们是{i}确定无疑{/i}的。

lines.en: First — somebody’s gonna get wienered.
lines.zh: 第一——有人要被香肠袭击了。

lines.en: Second — somebody’s gonna cry (maybe from getting wienered).
lines.zh: 第二——有人要哭（可能是因为被香肠袭击）。

lines.en: And third — entities above and below and off to the side will be watching {s}our{/s} your every move; {s}GOD{/s} God is watching to make sure your steps are stepped correctly.
lines.zh: 第三——上方、下方、还有旁边那些存在都在注视着你们的一举一动；{s}GOD{/s} 神在看着，确保你的每一步都踩得正确。

lines.en: Wizard hat. Glasses. You’re almost ready to go! A brand new destiny awaits you, passenger! And an older one awaits several others. But that’s a story for another day! One with fewer pumpkins/more trees.
lines.zh: 巫师帽。眼镜。你差不多可以出发了！崭新的命运在等着你，乘客！而几份陈旧的命运在等着另外几个人。不过那是另一个故事了！一个南瓜更少、树更多的故事。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween1
Our event chain begins in another tried and true and formulaic and boring and contrived and lame manner with Imani Imai (substitute) briefing the class before some other guy debriefs them (sex joke).
lines.zh: 我们的事件链以另一种同样久经考验、套路化、无聊、矫揉造作又烂的方式开始——Imani Imai（代课老师）先向全班交代注意事项，然后某个男的再来给他们「交代」一遍（黄色笑话）。

lines.en: What Imani Imai did not know, however, was that this Halloween wasn’t going to be like the other Halloweens. A thing was going to happen.
lines.zh: 然而 Imani Imai 不知道的是，这个万圣节不会和以往那些万圣节一样。会有事情发生。

lines.en: But not like the kind of thing where she accidentally fucks somebody and then they disappear because switching protagonists at this point in the race would make things really messy. No, a different thing.
lines.zh: 但不是那种她不小心和谁上了床、然后对方就消失不见的事情——毕竟在比赛进行到这个节骨眼换主角会让一切变得非常混乱。不，是另一回事。

lines.en: She probably wouldn’t have to worry about that though since she hasn’t really been intrinsically linked to any of the meta-plot stuff yet. But others have!
lines.zh: 不过她大概不用担心那个，因为她到现在还没有真正和任何元剧情的东西扯上内在联系。但别人有！

lines.en: And they’re just about buckled into their carts, so get in beside them and wait for your ride(s) to begin!
lines.zh: 而她们差不多已经坐进车厢、系好安全带了，所以你也挨着她们坐好，等着你的旅程（们）开始吧！

lines.en: Oh, and remember — seeing is believing. Hearing is not.
lines.zh: 哦，还有记住——眼见为实。耳听为虚。

lines.en: The new word of the day is {i}coaster!{/i} Getting ready to fall! With handlebar hands and iron legs, we ride! Together to the sunset! Together to the new world! Or the old one! Whichever COMES {b}fiRST!{/b}?
lines.zh: 今日新词是{i}过山车{/i}！准备坠落！用车把一样的手、铁打一样的腿，我们出发！一起奔向夕阳！一起奔向新世界！或者旧世界！哪个{b}先到{/b}就哪个！？

lines.en: : Okay! So if no one has any questions-
lines.zh: : 好了！那么如果没人有问题的话——

lines.en: : I have a question!
lines.zh: : 我有问题！

lines.en: : No, Kirin. I will not make out with you.
lines.zh: : 不行，Kirin。我不会和你接吻的。

lines.en: : Tch.
: I also have a question, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 我也有个问题，Imai 老师。

lines.en: : I won’t make out with you either, Touka. I don’t care how much you’re willing to pay.
lines.zh: : 我也不会和你接吻，Touka。不管你愿意出多少钱。

lines.en: : Wh...What? No. I’d just like to inquire about the situation with the “sad family” as you’ve written on the board.
lines.zh: : 什……什么？不是的。我只是想问一下你在黑板上写的那个「悲伤的家庭」是怎么回事。

lines.en: : Were you not paying attention  earlier? That’s in reference to the Arakawas since Senpai and Ami are both going to-
lines.zh: : 你刚才没在认真听吗？那说的是 Arakawa 家，因为 Senpai 和 Ami 都要——

lines.en: : Y-Yes! I’m aware of...who it’s in reference to. But are we certain that Ami’s reintroduction to the class is {i}safe{/i} given the...nature of departure?
lines.zh: : 是、是的！我知道……指的是谁。但我们确定让 Ami 重新回到班里是{i}安全{/i}的吗？考虑到她离开的……性质？

lines.en: scene anewhalloween2
: Well...no. But Senpai’s promised to keep her on a short leash.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不确定。但 Senpai 保证过会把她拴得紧紧的。

lines.en: : Either way though, Ami had a lot going on back then and I’d appreciate it if you girls could at least {i}try{/i} and welcome her back since she’ll be returning to class next Monday.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，Ami 那时候经历了很多，如果你们几个至少能{i}试着{/i}欢迎她回来，我会很感激——她下周一就回班上了。

lines.en: : Does that mean the Supreme Overlord will be making a comeback as well?!
lines.zh: : 那是不是意味着至高霸主也要回归了？！

lines.en: scene anewhalloween3
: You can ask him yourself once you get to Ayane’s place. He and some of the others are probably heading over there as we speak. All I’ve gotten confirmation on is Ami.
lines.zh: : 等你们到了 Ayane 家可以亲自问他。他和其他几个人大概这会儿正在往那边去。我只确认了 Ami 一个。

lines.en: : So, if there’s nothing else-
lines.zh: : 那么，如果没别的事——

lines.en: : I have something!
lines.zh: : 我有事！

lines.en: : No, Chika. I will not-
lines.zh: : 不行，Chika。我不会——

lines.en: : I just wanted to say that you’re looking extra young and awesome today, Imani. That’s all!
lines.zh: : 我只是想说你今天看起来格外年轻、格外棒，Imani。就这样！

lines.en: scene anewhalloween4
: You’re damn right, Chika! And thank you for following rule five! Ten points to the first floor for the next Dorm Wars!
lines.zh: : 说得太对了，Chika！还有谢谢你遵守第五条规则！下次宿舍战争给一楼加十分！

lines.en: : Ten?! But we normally only score like five total!
lines.zh: : 十分？！可我们平时总分也就五分左右啊！

lines.en: : Then I guess that just means you’ll all have to line up and start paying your tributes to me as well! Class dismissed!
lines.zh: : 那看来你们也得排着队开始向我进贡了！下课！

lines.en: scene anewhalloween5
: Miss Imai? Do you have a second?
lines.zh: : Imai 老师？你有空吗？

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. Here to praise me? Take as long as you need. I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。来夸我的？想说多久说多久。我一点都不介意。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween6
: Yes, you’re very youthful and beautiful. But that’s not what I wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 是的，你非常年轻貌美。但我想说的不是这个。

lines.en: : Okay. But if it’s a complaint about truth or dare being banned, you’re going to have to fill out a form and wait for me to get back to you after I review the other fifty.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但如果是投诉真心话大冒险被禁的事，你得先填张表，等我批完另外五十张再回复你。

lines.en: : I was just wondering if...you heard anything from my parents yet.
lines.zh: : 我只是想问……你有没有收到我父母的什么消息。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween7
: They still haven’t called you?
lines.zh: : 他们还没联系你吗？

lines.en: : I’m...sure it’s fine! I just can’t help but worry since they’ve never...lost contact for so long before.
lines.zh: : 我……相信没事的！我只是忍不住担心，因为他们从来没有……失联这么久过。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Futaba. I haven’t heard anything. But I can try contacting them again over the weekend if-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Futaba。我什么都没听说。不过我周末可以再试着联系他们一下，如果——

lines.en: scene anewhalloween8
: No! No, it’s fine. I’ll just...keep trying. You don’t have to worry about it.
lines.zh: : 不用！不，真的没事。我会……继续试着联系的。你不用担心。

lines.en: : If you say so...But in the meantime, if you need anyone to talk to-
lines.zh: : 既然你这么说……但在这期间，如果你需要找人聊聊——

lines.en: : I have you. I know. Thank you, Miss Imai.
lines.zh: : 我有你。我知道。谢谢你，Imai 老师。

lines.en: scene black
: That really...means a lot to me.
lines.zh: : 这真的……对我意义重大。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween9
: Why will my bangs not cooperate with me today? Have I done something to wrong them? Is this because I switched to Aussie? Has TikTok deceived me once more?
lines.zh: : 为什么我的刘海今天就是不听话？我是不是哪里得罪它了？是因为我换成 Aussie 了吗？TikTok 又一次欺骗了我吗？

lines.en: : They look the same as always, Uta.
lines.zh: : 和平时一样啊，Uta。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween10
: The same as always?! They’re not {i}supposed{/i} to look the same as always! I put a little gap here! There’s not normally a gap! But the gap keeps closing! I’m freaking out, Io!
lines.zh: : 和平时一样？！{i}不可以{/i}和平时一样啊！我在这儿留了个缝！平时是没有缝的！可这缝一直在合上！我要崩溃了，Io！

lines.en: : Sorry, let me start over. What exactly are you trying to do that...isn’t working?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我们重新来。你到底想弄成什么样……结果没弄成？

lines.en: scene anewhalloween11
: Ugh, I don’t even know! Just nothing I do is making me feel pretty today and I’m like two steps away from just shaving my head and becoming a monk.
lines.zh: : 呃，我自己也不知道！就是今天不管怎么弄都觉得自己不好看，我离干脆剃光头出家当尼姑就差两步了。

lines.en: : Who cares if you’re not feeling pretty?
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己不好看又有什么关系？

lines.en: scene anewhalloween12
: Me, obviously. This costume needs to be a total knockout. Sensei’s a millennial, Io. And do you know what millennials like? Final Fantasy VII.
lines.zh: : 当然是我了。这套服装必须得是全场最炸的。Sensei 是千禧一代，Io。你知道千禧一代喜欢什么吗？《最终幻想 VII》。

lines.en: : Is that...a fact?
lines.zh: : 这……是事实吗？

lines.en: : That and affordable student loans, yeah. And I’m not about to dress up as a friggin’ bank teller for Halloween. I want him to look at me more this year.
lines.zh: : 还有负担得起的助学贷款，对。而且我可不想为了万圣节打扮成个破银行柜员。我想让他今年多看看我。

lines.en: : So you just...chose to dress up as a character you know nothing about for the sole purpose of impressing the boy you like?
lines.zh: : 所以你就……为了讨好你喜欢的男生，挑了一个你一无所知的角色来扮？

lines.en: scene anewhalloween13
: Please don’t make me feel any more pathetic than I already do, Io. I’m already down bad.
lines.zh: : 别再让我觉得自己比现在更可悲了，Io。我已经够惨了。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to feel pathetic, Uta. I think that’s...really cute. In a...depressingly gross pandering sort of way that does nothing to accentuate any of your best qualities.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你觉得自己可悲，Uta。我觉得那样……挺可爱的。是一种……可悲到有点恶心的讨好方式，完全没有凸显出你任何的优点。

lines.en: : This friggin’ push-up bra better be accentuating my best qualities or Shein is going to have hell to pay once Halloween is over.
lines.zh: : 这件该死的聚拢胸罩最好有在凸显我的优点，否则万圣节一过 Shein 就等着好看吧。

lines.en: : I just meant that I think you’re at your best when you’re {i}you.{/i} Not Tifa Lockhart.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你做{i}你{/i}自己的时候才是最好的。而不是 Tifa Lockhart。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween14
: That’s very sweet of you. You are wrong.
lines.zh: : 你真贴心。但你错了。

lines.en: : Oh. My bad.
lines.zh: : 哦。我的错。

lines.en: : It’s okay. I forgive you. Now, please excuse me as I continue to have an identity crisis — which you are probably already very familiar with.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我原谅你。现在请允许我继续我的身份认同危机——这个你大概已经很熟悉了。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s fine. I’ll just sit here and go back to literally {i}being{/i} a crisis until you’re ready to talk about stuff that isn’t boring anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯，行吧。我就坐在这儿继续字面意义上地{i}当个{/i}危机，等你愿意聊点不那么无聊的东西为止。

lines.en: : Thank you. Cuteness: loading. Please wait.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。可爱度：加载中。请稍候。

lines.en: scene black
: Io, hold my mirror and aim it at my face. I’m going to try something.
lines.zh: : Io，帮我拿着镜子对着我的脸。我要试试看。

lines.en: : Yes, my queen. Anything to help you shrink yourself for the sole purpose of sexually appealing to a man.
lines.zh: : 遵命，我的女王。只要能帮你为了勾引男人而把自己缩小，我什么都愿意做。

lines.en: : Now you’re getting it, Io.
lines.zh: : 你开始上道了，Io。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween15
: Hey, uhh...did Imani get rid of rule two? Because I no longer feel safe in this environment.
lines.zh: : 嘿，呃……Imani 是不是把第二条规则取消了？因为我在这个环境里已经感觉不到安全了。

lines.en: : You’re literally not wearing pants right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在可是字面意义上没穿裤子啊。

lines.en: : Fine by me. Gives me easier access once it’s {i}my{/i} turn to be crushed on by Rin.
lines.zh: : 我无所谓。这样等轮到{i}我{/i}被 Rin 迷上的时候更方便下手。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween16
: Hands off, slut. I’d never let Rin settle for the likes of you.
lines.zh: : 把手拿开，婊子。我绝不会让 Rin 将就你这种货色。

lines.en: : And yes, I {i}am{/i} gate-keeping her. And there is nothing you can do about it.
lines.zh: : 对，我就{i}是{/i}在看门。而你拿我一点办法都没有。

lines.en: : Oh, Chika. If only you knew what Rin and I have {i}already{/i} been through together. She and I have the type of bond that can’t be forged by...wait, what forged your bond again? That time you rejected her?
lines.zh: : 哦，Chika。你要是知道我和 Rin 都{i}已经{/i}一起经历过什么就好了。她和我之间的那种羁绊是……等等，你们的羁绊是靠什么结成的来着？那次你拒绝她？

lines.en: : Kirin...
lines.zh: : Kirin……

lines.en: scene anewhalloween17
: I would never reject you, Rin. In fact, why don’t the two of us-
lines.zh: : 我绝不会拒绝你的，Rin。不如说，我们两个何不——

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween18
: Really?! Just like that?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！就这么干脆？！

lines.en: : Pfffft! Amazing!
lines.zh: : 噗哈哈哈！太精彩了！

lines.en: : Yeah, I prefer Nico over Nami. And Perona. And Vivi. And Boa. And pretty much every other girl in One Piece. Some of the guys too. {size=-15}Your boobs are also way too small for all of her post-timeskip costumes.{/size}
lines.zh: : 对，比起 Nami 我更喜欢 Nico。还有 Perona。还有 Vivi。还有 Boa。还有《海贼王》里几乎所有别的女生。有些男的也是。{size=-15}而且你胸太小了，她两年后那些衣服你根本撑不起来。{/size}

lines.en: scene anewhalloween19
: They’ll grow! Just look at Karin!
lines.zh: : 会长大的！你看看 Karin！

lines.en: : I do. Sometimes too much.
lines.zh: : 我天天在看。有时候看得太多了。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween20
: I liked this class more when Molly was the punching bag, not me.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢以前大家拿 Molly 当出气筒的时候，而不是我。

lines.en: : Well, stop putting your thong on display for everyone to see and maybe fewer people will call you out for  your sluttiness. Rin, are we still going to the party together?
lines.zh: : 那你别再把丁字裤露出来给人看了，也许就没人骂你骚了。Rin，我们还一起去派对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah — but do you mind if Futaba comes too? She’s not feeling great because of the whole thing with her parents.
lines.zh: : 嗯——不过你介意 Futaba 也来吗？她因为她爸妈那件事心情不太好。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween21
: Aww...poor thing. Of course she can come. I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 呜哇……可怜的孩子。她当然可以来。我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : Can I come too? Noriko and Miku both went over early to set things up and-
lines.zh: : 我也能去吗？Noriko 和 Miku 都提前过去布置了，而且——

lines.en: scene anewhalloween22
: No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : That was quick.
lines.zh: : 答得真快。

lines.en: : It was an easy decision.
lines.zh: : 这决定很容易做。

lines.en: : Wow. I never realized how much you two dislike each other.
lines.zh: : 哇。我以前真不知道你们俩这么讨厌对方。

lines.en: : Chika doesn’t actually hate me. We secretly want to fuck each other and this is just how we flirt.
lines.zh: : Chika 其实并不讨厌我。我们暗地里都想上对方，这只是我们调情的方式。

lines.en: : No, I actually hate you.
lines.zh: : 不，我真的讨厌你。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, shit.
lines.zh: : 唉，操。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween23
: I will concede that you are sometimes kind of hot, though. {i}Kind of.{/i} Don’t let it go to your head.
lines.zh: : 不过我承认你有时候确实挺辣的。{i}就一点点{/i}。别得意忘形。

lines.en: : It’s already there. Hearing that is actually {i}better{/i} than hearing you like me since it opens up the possibility of a threesome.
lines.zh: : 已经得意了。听到这句其实比听到你喜欢我还{i}好{/i}，因为这样就有了三人行的可能性。

lines.en: : Not a fucking-
lines.zh: : 不是他妈的——

lines.en: scene anewhalloween24
: {i}Actually...{/i}
scene anewhalloween25
: Wait, ew. No. Not in a million years. Why did I even hesitate?
lines.zh: : 等等，恶心。不行。一百万年都不行。我刚才犹豫个什么劲？

lines.en: scene black
: Rin, come on. I need to stop back at the dorms first. We can take a taxi from there.
lines.zh: : Rin，走了。我得先回一趟宿舍。我们可以从那儿打车。

lines.en: : So am I-
lines.zh: : 那我——

lines.en: : Not invited! Sorry! Just not really!
lines.zh: : 没邀请你！抱歉！就是真的没有！

lines.en: : Ughhhhh {i}Rin?{/i} Can’t you reason with her? Didn’t our passionate mechanical double-date mean anything to-
lines.zh: : 呜啊啊啊 {i}Rin{/i}？你就不能劝劝她吗？我们那场激情的机械双重约会难道什么都不算吗——

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 不用了。

lines.en: : Stop rejecting me so quickly! I have pride, you know!
lines.zh: : 别拒绝得这么快啊！我也是有自尊心的，你知道吗！

lines.en: scene anewhalloween26
: ...and that’s why I hate working with latex!
lines.zh: : ……所以这就是为什么我讨厌用乳胶做东西！

lines.en: : I lost track of how many times the Emerald Guardian needed to lubricate my body in order to get this costume to properly fit.
lines.zh: : 我都数不清翡翠守护者往我身上涂了多少次润滑，才让这套衣服合身。

lines.en: : Yup! It was totally unenjoyable and I absolutely hated the fact that I had to do that so many times!
lines.zh: : 对！那过程一点都不享受，我绝对、非常讨厌自己不得不做那么多次！

lines.en: : I am...quite surprised you’re even open to wearing something that revealing, Tsuneyo. I’m beginning to believe what you said about being an exhibitionist might actually be true.
lines.zh: : 我……很惊讶你竟然愿意穿这么暴露的衣服，Tsuneyo。我开始相信你说的自己是暴露狂可能真有其事了。

lines.en: : It’s not a crime to-
lines.zh: : 这又不犯——

lines.en: scene anewhalloween27
: Wait...exhibitionist? You? The Kendo Princess?
lines.zh: : 等等……暴露狂？你？剑道公主？

lines.en: : You haven’t been using my PC, have you? Because if I left any tabs open, they were definitely just pop-ups. I have a virus. Many viruses. Don’t ever look at my PC under any circumstances.
lines.zh: : 你该不会动过我的电脑吧？因为如果我忘了关什么标签页，那些绝对都只是弹窗。我中毒了。很多病毒。任何时候都绝对不许看我的电脑。

lines.en: : A true exhibitionist does not reveal her exhibitions. I am an enigma. There can be no truth to discover about me, for there {i}is{/i} no truth at all. I am but a Rubik’s Cube, bro. Deal with it.
lines.zh: : 真正的暴露狂不会暴露自己的暴露。我是个谜。关于我没有什么真相可以发现，因为根本就{i}没有{/i}真相。我不过是一个魔方，老兄。接受吧。

lines.en: : Rubik’s Cubes can be solved rather simply, actually. My record is seventy-four seconds.
lines.zh: : 魔方其实解起来挺简单的。我的纪录是七十四秒。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween28
: Do you think you are better than me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你比我强？
: 呃……我……没有？

lines.en: : Don’t be intimidated by her just because she could separate your head from your body in three seconds flat. The Kendo Princess just isn’t very good at puzzles.
lines.zh: : 别因为她能在三秒内把你的头和身体分开就怕她。剑道公主只是不太擅长解谜而已。

lines.en: : Prepare to die, Thursday Smith.
lines.zh: : 受死吧，Thursday Smith。

lines.en: : Wednesday Addams.
lines.zh: : Wednesday Addams。

lines.en: : Monday Jones.
lines.zh: : Monday Jones。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween29
: I have finished praying. I am ready to be engulfed by spirits.
lines.zh: : 我祈祷完了。我已经准备好被幽灵吞噬了。

lines.en: : And you made it all the way over here without me having to come get you! I’m so very proud, Yasu!
lines.zh: : 而且你一路自己走到了这儿，都不用我去接你！我太为你骄傲了，Yasu！

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka. I apologize for being such a burden every second of every day.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Touka。我很抱歉每一分每一秒都这么累赘。

lines.en: : I know the Emerald Guardian’s craftsmanship when I see it. Those fabrics were splayed out across our bedroom floor mere weeks ago. Return them now or face my blade.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者的手艺我一眼就认得出来。那些布料几个星期前还摊在我们卧室的地板上。现在还回来，否则尝我刀刃。

lines.en: : Cease, Ram. Yasu’s merely wearing what I asked her to as I thought she’d make an excellent Frieren, but...something seems off.
lines.zh: : 住手，Ram。Yasu 只是穿了我让她穿的，我觉得她扮 Frieren 会非常合适，但……好像哪里不对劲。

lines.en: : You are correct, Emerald Guardian. I can see several areas where you’ve made errors in stitching.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，翡翠守护者。我能看出你好几处缝错了。

lines.en: : No I meant with-
lines.zh: : 不，我是说——

lines.en: scene anewhalloween30
: Wait, where?! Near the collar? But I-
lines.zh: : 等等，哪里？！领口附近吗？可我——

lines.en: : Before you...fall into the rabbit hole of inspecting your hard work, I believe I know what you’re referring to. And I can assure you it’s no problem at all.
lines.zh: : 在你……掉进检查自己心血的兔子洞之前，我想我知道你指的是什么。我可以保证那完全不是问题。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween31
: Really? Then...is she just tired or something? She seemed so excited the last time she tried on the costume and now she’s barely a step above undead.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那……她只是累了还是怎么？上次试衣服的时候她还那么兴奋，现在却比活死人强不了多少。

lines.en: : Yasu, why don’t you tell Molly what’s really going on? You can handle that, right?
lines.zh: : Yasu，不如你告诉 Molly 到底是怎么回事？你能行的，对吧？

lines.en: : The Tsukioka family has graciously provided the resources I need to heal. For the first time, I am present. I am here. I am Yasu Yasui. I am a normal girl.
lines.zh: : Tsukioka 家慷慨地提供了我疗伤所需的资源。这是我第一次在场。我在这里。我是 Yasu Yasui。我是一个普通的女孩。

lines.en: : Very well done, Yasu!
lines.zh: : 说得非常好，Yasu！

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Touka。

lines.en: : Yeah, I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween32
: Oh, thank goodness. I was worried it was just me.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。我还以为只有我这么觉得。

lines.en: : While getting Yasu psychiatric help was of utmost importance to my family and me, I can’t help but second-guess our actions now that I’ve seen what medication has done to the poor girl.
lines.zh: : 虽然让 Yasu 接受精神治疗对我和我的家人来说是头等大事，但看到药物把这个可怜的女孩变成了这样，我忍不住开始怀疑我们的做法。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Touka. Nothing I do will ever be good enough for you or anyone else.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Touka。我做什么都永远不够好，对你、对任何人都一样。

lines.en: : Of all the qualities to keep, why’d it have to be the self-loathing?
lines.zh: : 那么多特质里偏偏保留了这一个，为什么非得是自我厌弃啊？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but I’ll be speaking to my mother shortly since this is just...not the Yasu I know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但我稍后会跟我母亲谈谈，因为这真的……不是我认识的那个 Yasu。

lines.en: : But how does {i}she{/i} feel about it?
lines.zh: : 但{i}她{/i}自己感觉如何呢？

lines.en: : Yasu...do you understand the question? Do you feel any different now that you’re not...your former self anymore?
lines.zh: : Yasu……你明白这个问题吗？既然你不再是……以前那个自己了，你感觉有什么不同吗？

lines.en: : I have never been anything. I will never be anything. I am a bug. That is all.
lines.zh: : 我从来什么都不是。我永远什么都不是。我是一只虫子。仅此而已。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah...I think you should probably talk to your mom.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得你还是该去跟你妈聊聊。

lines.en: scene anewhalloween33
: Nodoka? Are you-
lines.zh: : Nodoka？你是不是——

lines.en: : {i}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!{/i}

lines.en: scene anewhalloween34
: Oh, okay. I guess not much has changed then.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。看来没什么太大变化。

lines.en: : {i}Nothing’s changed at all! No matter what I do, I keep ending up exactly where I started! Nothing makes sense! It’s all fucking wrong!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么都没变！不管我做什么，最后都会回到原点！一切都毫无道理！全他妈是错的！{/i}

lines.en: : Sooooo...no Halloween party then?
lines.zh: : 那……所以万圣节派对是不去了？

lines.en: scene anewhalloween35
: Fuck Halloween! You think I can afford making time to masturbate with so many secrets slipping through my fingers?! They’ll get stuck inside me, damn it! Then I’ll never get them out!
lines.zh: : 去他妈的万圣节！你觉得我有闲工夫在这种时候自慰吗？那么多秘密正从我指缝里溜走！它们会卡在我身体里的，该死！那样我就永远弄不出来了！

lines.en: : {i}Nodoka, you’ve been at it for days. You need to take a break or you’re literally going to die and then no one will ever figure out the “secrets of the universe.”{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Nodoka，你已经连着搞了好几天了。你得休息一下，否则你会字面意义上地死掉，那样就永远没人能搞懂「宇宙的秘密」了。{/i}

lines.en: : Take a break?! Now?! You think I can just turn this shit off?! Fuck you! You know what you’d do if I asked {i}you{/i} to take a break while you’re working?! You’d fuck me! That’s what!
lines.zh: : 休息？！现在？！你觉得我能把这玩意儿关掉吗？！操{i}你{/i}的！你知道我要是在你工作的时候叫你休息，你会怎么做吗？！你会上我！就是这样！

lines.en: : {i}That is more assuredly not a thing I would ever do no matter how engrossed in work I am.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这种事无论我多投入工作都绝对做不出来。{/i}

lines.en: : Pussy! I could make you cum harder than anyone and you know it! Slut! Bitch! Shut up! Go away!
lines.zh: : 怂包！我能让你比任何人都爽，你心里清楚！婊子！贱人！闭嘴！滚开！

lines.en: : {i}Listen — if you’re not going to come to the party, that’s fine. I’ll find someone else to chill with there. But you’ve gotta fucking rest, Nodoka. I’m worried about you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}听着——你不来派对也没关系。我会找别人在那儿一起玩。但你他妈必须休息，Nodoka。我很担心你。{/i}

lines.en: scene anewhalloween36
: Well, worry about something else! Do you have any idea what percentage of koalas have chlamydia?! It’s an alarming percentage, Otoha! Worry about that! I’m busy!
lines.zh: : 那你担心点别的去吧！你知道有多少比例的考拉患有衣原体吗？！那个比例高得吓人，Otoha！去担心那个！我忙着呢！

lines.en: : {i}Nodoka-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Nodoka——{/i}

lines.en: : I SAID I’M FUCKING BUSY! STOP CALLING!
lines.zh: : 我说了老子在忙！别再打来了！

lines.en: : {i}Your mom wouldn’t want this.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你妈妈不会希望看到你这样的。{/i}

lines.en: scene anewhalloween35
: I know that, you fucking moron!
lines.zh: : 我知道，你这白痴！

lines.en: scene anewhalloween37
: That’s why I have to do it.
lines.zh: : 所以我才非做不可。

lines.en: scene black
: {i}I’ll call you later, okay?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我晚点打给你，好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Don’t! Go fuck someone! Get pregnant and have a son and then fuck your son! Then after {i}he{/i} gets you pregnant, you can call me! That’s when I’ll be free! Not a minute before then!
lines.zh: : 别打！去操人吧！怀孕生个儿子，然后操你儿子！等{i}他{/i}把你搞怀孕之后你再打给我！那时候我才有空！一分钟都不行提前！

lines.en: : {i}Okay. So like three or four hours?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好的。那大概三四个小时以后？{/i}

lines.en: : YOU FUCKING- AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH! YOU DON’T EVEN REALIZE THE IMPLICATIONS OF WHAT YOU JUST SAID, DO YOU?! DON’T EVER SPEAK OF HOURS OR TIME AT ALL AGAIN! FUCK YOU! BYE!
lines.zh: : 你他妈的——啊啊啊啊啊啊！你根本不明白你刚说的话意味着什么，是吧？！以后再也不许提小时、提时间！操你的！再见！

lines.en: : {i}Later, Nodoka...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}回见，Nodoka……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Be careful.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}小心点。{/i}
